## Appearance

Anne is a skinny, tall girl with a thin little body and a pointed, freckled face illuminated by solemn gray eyes. Her most prominent feature is her hair, which is described as red or splendid [Titian](../character/titian.md), and is worn in long red braids. When dressed up, she presents a stylish and notably different appearance.

## Personality

Anne is a highly imaginative, smart, and quick-learning individual with a natural knack for reciting. Though she is willing to work hard and remain obedient, she can also be heedless and impulsive, frequently speaking or acting without reflection. Driven to succeed for the sake of [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), her primary goals are to pass her examinations high and win the Avery scholarship through sheer effort.

## History

Orphaned as an infant, Anne was raised moving between homes, taking care of children, and living in an orphan asylum before being adopted by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Though initially taken in by mistake instead of a boy, Anne proved her worth to the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) and was allowed to stay. She quickly made a deep home for herself at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), forming a fierce friendship with [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) and navigating early mishaps, such as accidentally serving [Diana](../character/diana.md) currant wine and accidentally flavoring a cake with anodyne liniment for the new minister's wife. Anne also developed an intense academic rivalry with her classmate [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), which began after he pulled her hair and called her 'Carrots' on his first day back at school.

Over the years, Anne blossomed into a talented student under the mentorship of her teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), winning over difficult figures like Diana's formidable great-aunt, [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md), and excelling in community events like a school [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert where [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) gifted her a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves. She eventually tied with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) on the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations. While attending Queen's, Anne won the prestigious Avery scholarship. However, upon returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), tragedy struck when [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) died suddenly from the shock of a bank failure, leaving Anne and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to grieve together and look toward an uncertain future.

## Quotes

> "Well, that is another hope gone. ‘My life is a perfect graveyard of buried hopes.’ That’s a sentence I read in a book once, and I say it over to comfort myself whenever I’m disappointed in anything."
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003)

> “Oh, what I know about myself isn’t really worth telling,” said Anne eagerly. “If you’ll only let me tell you what I imagine about myself you’ll think it ever so much more interesting.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009)

> “I was afraid it might be Mrs. Spencer’s place,” said Anne mournfully. “I don’t want to get there. Somehow, it will seem like the end of everything.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P26](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0026)

> “I—I saw it this afternoon when you were away at the Aid Society,” said Anne, a little slowly. “I was passing your door when I saw it on the cushion, so I went in to look at it.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002)

> “I did put it back,” said Anne quickly—pertly, Marilla thought. “I don’t just remember whether I stuck it on the pincushion or laid it in the china tray. But I’m perfectly certain I put it back.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P8](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0008)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne.md)

[Allan](../character/allan.md) is the new minister in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) whom Anne deeply respects and considers a kindred spirit alongside his wife. She goes to great lengths to impress them, even baking a layer cake for their visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), though it ends in disaster when she accidentally flavors it with liniment. Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) responds with kindness, comforting a mortified Anne and fostering a warm, friendly bond between them.

- Friend of — kindred spirits and minister's wife  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006)</sub>

### [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--bertha-shirley.md)

[Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) was Anne's mother who passed away when Anne was a baby. Anne remembers her through the story of her past, which she recounts to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) while driving to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). Learning about Bertha's death and Anne's subsequent upbringing as an orphan leads [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to feel deep pity for Anne's neglected childhood.
